# Template: ecg_strip
An ECG (electrocardiogram) rhythm strip: a computed cardiac waveform on light graph paper, with the classic rhythms as presets — normal sinus, bradycardia, tachycardia, atrial fibrillation (irregularly irregular, no P waves), ventricular tachycardia (wide complexes), STEMI (ST elevation) and third-degree heart block (P waves and QRS marching independently) — plus optional P/QRS/T labels on the first beat and a rate caption. Choose this scene for ANY request about an ECG or EKG, electrocardiogram, heart rhythm or arrhythmia, P wave / QRS complex / T wave anatomy, atrial fibrillation, tachycardia or bradycardia, heart block, or the trace of a myocardial infarction.
Parameter schema:
{
 "type": "object",
 "properties": {
  "rhythm": {
   "type": "string",
   "enum": [
    "normal",
    "bradycardia",
    "tachycardia",
    "afib",
    "vt",
    "stemi",
    "heart_block"
   ],
   "description": "Which rhythm to draw (default normal). heart_block is third-degree: independent P and QRS trains."
  },
  "rate": {
   "type": "integer",
   "description": "Beats per minute, 20-220. Defaults per rhythm (normal 75, bradycardia 45, tachycardia 130, afib ~110, vt 180, stemi 80, heart_block 40 ventricular)."
  },
  "seconds": {
   "type": "number",
   "description": "Strip length in seconds, 3-10 (default 6)."
  },
  "show_grid": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "Light ECG graph-paper grid behind the trace (default true)."
  },
  "labels": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "Label P, QRS and T on the first beat (default true; only drawn for rhythms that have them)."
  },
  "title": {
   "type": "string"
  }
 }
}
Element ids your commands can reference:
- grid: the graph-paper grid (a group), when show_grid
- trace: the ECG waveform itself
- rate_label: the rate caption under the strip
- label_p: "P" on the first beat's P wave (when labels and the rhythm has P waves)
- label_qrs: "QRS" on the first beat's R peak (when labels)
- label_t: "T" on the first beat's T wave (when labels)
- label_st: "ST elevation" caption (stemi only, when labels)
- st_pointer: arrow from that caption to the elevated ST segment (stemi only, when labels)
- title: figure title, when set
Examples:
Request: "Draw a normal ECG with the P wave, QRS complex and T wave labeled." → params: {"rhythm":"normal","title":"Normal sinus rhythm"}
Request: "Show atrial fibrillation on an ECG strip." → params: {"rhythm":"afib","seconds":6,"title":"Atrial fibrillation"}

In YAML: `template: ecg_strip` and `params:` per the schema above; commands name the element ids above.
